title: arisaema speirophyllum subsp. boreale
intro: Arisaema speirophyllum subsp. boreale, commonly known as the northern cobra lily, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Arum family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and pain, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of the northern cobra lily include alkaloids and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal effects. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
